recipes.name: Mama Moe's Scalloped Potatoes
ingredients_raw: 1 (10.75 ounce) can condensed cream of potato soup
1 (10.75 ounce) can condensed cream of mushroom soup

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).

Stir together the cream of potato soup, cream of mushroom soup and onion in a bowl. Heat in the microwave until hot, about 3 minutes. Make a layer of potato slices in the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Cover with a layer of the soup mixture and then sprinkle with some of the cheese. Repeat layers until ingredients are used up.
Bake in the preheated oven until potatoes are fork-tender and cheese is browned on top, about 1 hour.

raw_recipe.headline: Mama Moe's Scalloped Potatoes
raw_recipe.description: Yukon Gold potatoes are sliced and layered with creamy sauce and Cheddar cheese before baking until tender and golden brown. So full of flavor and cheesy! Yummy!

review.reviewBody: It's really tiresome to read "reviews" by people who haven't tried a dish because they think it has too many calories, fat or whatever. The food police need to learn that if they don't like the nutritional values, they are perfectly free to NOT make a recipe, but they have no business giving a recipe they have not even tried a poor rating.

I halved this recipe and still had a half full 9x13 dish (with about 4-5 servings worth). I only used 1 can of cream of mushroom soup since I halved it, otherwise followed instructions and ingredients. We all really enjoyed these!! I think next time I would add a little salt and some pepper to the layers of potatoes for a little more flavor, but the cheese and soup amount was great and I really liked the creaminess from them!

This is the best!!! Only thing that I changed was to use russet potatoes, as that's what I had, and adding about 3/4 cup milk to the mix. I also always use reduced sodium cream of mushroom soup. Soooo goooood!!!!!!!

I made this recipe for a big family gathering. I used a 9x13 pan . I used the Yukon gold potatoes. I did not peel the potatoes. I sliced them fairly thin . I made 2 layers. I doubled the soup & onion ingredients. It took 3 lbs of potatoes & total of 3 cups of cheese. It will definitely be my go to recipe. Everyone went on at how delicious they were!!!!

These are by far the best scalloped potatoes we have ever eaten. We did add some cubed left-over ham in each layer. I have made many recipes "the old-fashioned way" and am removing all of my other recipes from my files. Too good to make any other way and so easy!!

I have made this, and will make it again. I cubed a ham steak to mix in, and served with a veggie and apple sauce. The soup gives it a much creamier texture than the thin, runny, milky way my mom made them!

This recipe was easy to make. The only thing I did different was just mixed all the ingredients in a bowl together rather then layer it. Making sure to save some of the cheese to spread on top. YUM YUM

Great cheesy dish. As others have suggested, the prep and cooking time are understated. I used 3 potatoes, one can of mushroom soup and halved the rest of the ingredients. I added more liquid which got absorbed. I would serve this again.
Yummy yummy yummy!!! Made exactly as written but used a pre-shredded Tex Mex cheese blend instead of cheddar. It was excellent!

First off, let me just say I'm not a cook, nor a foodie. That said, I do like to cook, so I can bring something to potlucks or family gatherings that I can proudly say "I made it". I almost didn't make this recipe because it was just too simple, but I did anyway. It was a huge hit. There were leftovers of other dishes, but not this one. I received many compliments ranging from "nailed it" to "you won my heart". Suffice it to say, I'll be making this one again. The only thing I added was minced garlic, and that's it. I didn't even measure it, just added some. Thank you Mama Moe!

Very good and easy recipe! I used two cans of fat free cream of chicken soup because that is what I always have on hand and 2% shredded cheddar cheese with red potatoes and the family loved it. The only issue I had was that my prep time and cook time were way longer then you have in the recipe. It was 30 minutes prep and two hours cooking...the cooking time may have something to do with the red potatoes not sure, I did cut them very thin. Overall I will totally make this easy and pretty healthy recipe again!!

Adjusted to triple the liquid so that it comes out creamy and not dry. Don't like ham but love bacon so only used bacon and it still came out delish. Keeps well in the fridge and freezer. 4 stars bc it needed to be adjusted a bit but otherwise good recipe.
My late mother-in-law made her scalloped potatoes this way. She was an awesome cook.
This dish turned out amazing! Cheese was super creamy and potato’s nice and tender!
Easypeasy. Followed the recipe. Cooked 75 minutes and used spray butter on each potato layer, and lightly salted and pepper each layer too. Came out great.
These potatoes are SOOO delicious!!! They're the best we've ever had!!! This will definitely be one of my fave regularly repeated recipes!!!!

I made this recipe for Easter dinner. The sauce was great but I needed to cook the potatoes close to 1 hour 45 mins. With this being my first time with the recipe it threw of my ham and other sides. outside of the cook time discrepancy I will definitely does this one again

This recipe is 10 stars..... i made this for my mom and dad because they wanted the box stuff.... ewww.... they will never ever go back to the box stuff....This recipe is the best!!!!! thanx so much for posting this....:)

I halved it and it was terrific.
